svg.aria-label: How to write ൬ ൭ ൮: 3 letters, ൬, ൭, ൮, one after another
svg.title: Writing ൬ ൭ ൮
svg.desc: 3 letters written one after another: ൬, ൭, ൮ (malayalam). Each letter has its own group of frames; frame N of a group shows movements 1 to N of that letter, the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansMalayalam-Static.ttf. Each letter is drawn at its own scale from its own cited stroke order, so the strip does not show how large the letters are next to each other, how far apart they sit, or any join between them. Stroke order: ൬: Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026), js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൬; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0 <https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree/blob/e0c9d57dd32031c948da4d5f8432aae3e22c5bba/js/src/stroke-data.raw.json>; ൭: Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026), js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൭; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0 <https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree/blob/e0c9d57dd32031c948da4d5f8432aae3e22c5bba/js/src/stroke-data.raw.json>; ൮: Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026), js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൮; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0 <https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree/blob/e0c9d57dd32031c948da4d5f8432aae3e22c5bba/js/src/stroke-data.raw.json>. Source notes on variation: ൬: Jayasree records ൬ as one stroke: up the left side, over the first arch and down the first stem to its foot, back up it, over the second arch and down the second stem, back up it, then over the third arch, down the right side and round below the line to the left (start lower left, end below the line in the middle). Each climb retraces its stem. Jayasree keeps one recorded gesture per pen-down stroke, so one stroke means the recorder did not lift. Only these facts (stroke count, start, order, direction and end) are taken; no recorded coordinate is copied. The stroke data is licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) as "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree; this record adapts it, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to the recording, which was drawn over the Manjari typeface. One recorder, so confidence is medium. ൭: Jayasree records ൭ as one stroke: from the inner end of the small loop, clockwise round it, up the left side and over the top, then down the right and round below the line to the left (start at the inner loop, end below the line at the left). Noto joins the loop's inner end to the outer stroke, so the path starts at that join. Jayasree keeps one recorded gesture per pen-down stroke, so one stroke means the recorder did not lift. Only these facts (stroke count, start, order, direction and end) are taken; no recorded coordinate is copied. The stroke data is licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) as "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree; this record adapts it, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to the recording, which was drawn over the Manjari typeface. One recorder, so confidence is medium. ൮: Jayasree records ൮ as one stroke: up the left side, clockwise over the top and down to the foot, right along the baseline, up the right stem to its top, then back down it and round below the line to the left (start lower left, end below the line at the left). The descent retraces the stem. Jayasree keeps one recorded gesture per pen-down stroke, so one stroke means the recorder did not lift. Only these facts (stroke count, start, order, direction and end) are taken; no recorded coordinate is copied. The stroke data is licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) as "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree; this record adapts it, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to the recording, which was drawn over the Manjari typeface. One recorder, so confidence is medium.
svg.text: How it is written — 3 letters, one after another
Letter 1 of 3 — one unbroken stroke · 6 movements
Letter 2 of 3 — one unbroken stroke · 3 movements
Letter 3 of 3 — one unbroken stroke · 5 movements
Letter 1: stroke order after Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026),
js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൬; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0
Letter 2: stroke order after Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026),
js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൭; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0
Letter 3: stroke order after Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026),
js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൮; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0
This order is attested, not standardised; the source records where it varies.
